title: Backup Freshness Alert (system_check source)
description: Widening of WorkflowAlertEnvelopeV1 to carry a non-operation system check. Operation-scoped fields are absent rather than synthesized. NOTE: persisting this envelope requires an Alembic migration relaxing three CHECK constraints on workflow_terminal_events (ck_..._source_kind, ck_..._event_identity, ck_..._source_shape) — see design D5.

event_key.description: Single grammar for every backup freshness alert, stale and no_history alike; the condition is carried in `codes`, not in the key. The suffix is the check-window start as epoch seconds, which is what makes emission idempotent per window. Deliberately lowercase-and-digits only: the existing WorkflowEventKey type constrains keys to ^[a-z0-9:_-]+$, so an ISO-8601 stamp (uppercase T/Z, dot) would be rejected at construction. This exact literal form must also be admitted by the widened ck_workflow_terminal_events_event_identity CHECK.

operation_id.description: Absent for system checks. Explicitly null rather than synthesized — a fabricated operation id would produce a diagnostic URL that 404s. Requires the source_shape CHECK to admit null for this kind.

diagnostic_url.description: Reuses the existing, already-allowlisted workflow-terminal-events route rather than introducing /api/v1/health/backup. That route does not exist, is not in validate_diagnostic_route's allowlist, and would require an OpenAPI delta and an owning package. Absolute because the model field is AnyUrl, not a relative path.

counts.description: Manifest age in seconds and per-store outcome tallies. Carries the partial-run signal so a fresh-but-partial manifest is distinguishable from a healthy one. No credentials.
